name: fortnite-pirate-shop-access-drop-rates
lines:
بعد ضغط من اللاعبين
نشرت إيبك غيمز النسب

رمز Pirate Shop Access
يتيح أغراضًا مؤهلة 14 يومًا

تقول إيبك غيمز إن نسب
الصناديق ثابتة منذ 1 نوفمبر

خلال Treasure Hours
يُضرب احتمال الرمز في 1.5
credits: المصدر: إيبك غيمز (Epic Games)، إعلان Treasure Hunters
headline:
فرصة 1 من 137,500
لرمز متجر Fortnite
label: تقرير
source: حساب Fortnite Status عبر آي جي إن (IGN)

reel_check.SOURCE primary read: n/a: Fortnite Status post 402 to our fetch (opening text seen in a search snippet), IGN blocked; Beebom and Gfinity read in full and agree on every figure; chip تقرير attributed to IGN; gate 07:45Z in the story file
reel_check.SOURCE not already posted: yes: ledger find recorded, 0 hits for this story; the 1 Nov Fortnite One Piece Reel is a different story (new news framing: odds disclosure)

reel_check.ANGLE hook/why now/players/payoff: yes: hook 1 in 137,500 per chest for the token; why now Epic published the odds after player pressure (per IGN); for players: what the token gives (eligible Item Shop items for 14 days), the other odds, the Treasure Hours boost; payoff: rates constant since 1 Nov, Treasure Hours multiply the token odds by 1.5
reel_check.STORY TYPE items: yes: numbers: figure 1 in 137,500, per chest in a normal match, source Fortnite Status via IGN, comparison the gold outfit 1 in 1,562,500 and any Gizmo 1 in 127 on the strip
reel_check.STORY one spoken paragraph: yes: after player pressure Epic published the chest odds; Pirate Shop Access lets players claim eligible shop items for 14 days; Epic says the chest rates are constant since 1 Nov; in Treasure Hours the token's odds are multiplied by 1.5
reel_check.STORY subject before pronoun, no line on: yes: Epic named in line 1, the token in line 2; lines open on بعد, رمز, تقول, خلال
reel_check.STORY names: yes: إيبك غيمز per names-ar (credit line carries the Latin first), آي جي إن (IGN) per glossary; Treasure Hours, Pirate Shop Access, Gizmo, V-Bucks stay English as the publisher writes them
